grouping.method: Unaltered UUID fields are used as an inferred recording-batch key. This is not a verified signer identity.

reasons: 1 recording-group key(s) occur in more than one split; neighbouring frames are not isolated.

limitations: No signer or session metadata is shipped with data/train or data/test; group keys are inferred from filename UUIDs.
The existing data/test split is not signer-independent and must not be described as external generalization.
Exact duplicates cannot be detected after lossy re-encoding; use the near-duplicate report as a lower bound.

proposed_grouped_validation_split.description: Grouped validation split over the training split only. The test split is not touched. Not applied automatically.
